<h2>Collect sjSDM Tuning Summaries</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Reads compact resolution-specific tuning summaries from isolated unit
targets stores for a shared tier-selection stage.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>collect_sjsdm_tuning_summaries(
  store_paths = NULL,
  resolution_ids = NULL,
  target_prefix = "data_sjsdm_tuning_summary",
  target_names = NULL,
  read_target_function = targets::tar_read_raw
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="store_paths">store_paths</code></td>
<td>
<p>Non-empty character vector of unit targets-store paths.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="resolution_ids">resolution_ids</code></td>
<td>
<p>Non-empty character vector of mapped model-resolution identifiers.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="target_prefix">target_prefix</code></td>
<td>
<p>Non-empty character scalar placed before each resolution identifier.
Defaults to the existing public tuning-summary target prefix. Explicit
round prefixes allow the tier store to collect one staged round at a time.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="target_names">target_names</code></td>
<td>
<p>Optional character vector paired with 'resolution_ids'. When supplied,
reads these exact public target names instead of constructing suffixed names.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="read_target_function">read_target_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Injectable target reader. Defaults to [targets::tar_read_raw()].</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Bound tuning-summary tibble with 'source_store' and 'resolution_id'
provenance columns. Every requested store-resolution target must be
readable. The function aborts with the failed store and target when
evidence is incomplete.
</p>


<h3>Examples</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>## Not run:
collect_sjsdm_tuning_summaries(
  store_paths = c("store_a", "store_b"),
  resolution_ids = c("genus", "family")
)

## End(Not run)
</code></pre>

</main>
